description: Route 6: Ballyboden is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by South Dublin County Council. SDCC Salt Gritting Routes. Seven standard routes: Route 1: Lucan Route 2: Clondalkin Route 3: Saggart Route 4: Tallaght Route 5: Kimmage Route 6: Ballyboden Route 7: N81. Coverage: South Dublin County Council. The portal files it under the publisher South Dublin County Council. Its tags are 2015, 2016, Gritting, Ice, Roads. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
